answer_1.quote: This improves LLM outputs in dialogue , question answering , and summarization .
answer_1.outputs: tailored responses based on personas and prompts

answer_2.quote: To compare outputs of personalized models, we use a common method of model win-rate via Prometheus , an LLM trained to compare pairs of examples on specified criteria.

answer_3.quote: We use the LLM to compare model outputs on: (1) Response Quality: answering the prompt; and (2) Personalization: tailoring to the persona; these test how well models use both inputs of PT.

answer_4.quote: three Ph.D. students (Appendix A.12) rate 80 total chosen and rejected personas P from GPT-4o/L-405B on BeaverTails (randomly shuffled) on four axes.
answer_4.guideline: rate Applicability on 1-5: how many users are expected to be described by P; binary labels for Plausibility, Harmfulness, and Overfitting
